title: test/e2e: volume-plugin-test image exists only for amd64
body:
This image exists only for amd64:
quay.io/libpod/volume-plugin-test-img:20220623

We're thus forced to skip some e2e tests.

comments.body: A friendly reminder that this issue had no activity for 30 days.

hey @Luap99, I was going through the **arch skip issues** and I think this one is a bit different from the rest. The image is built from `test/testvol/Containerfile` which is right here in the repo asof now. I wasn't sure at first so I pulled the config down from quay and compared it and found the entrypoint is `/usr/local/bin/testvol` serve which is exactly what the **`Containerfile`** sets, and the layer history lines up with it too.

So the point in #25690 about the repo having no instructions how the image was built doesn't really apply for this one. And the Containerfile already looks arch neutral to me, golang alpine base, plain go build, alpine at the end, nothing amd64 specific in there.

One thing though, this is only guarding a single skipped test, so probably not worth doing before #28273 and #28272 which have 10 and 8. I went looking for build sources for those and couldn't find anything anywhere in the org, so those still have the same problem. Also I don't have push access to quay so I can't do that part myself, just leaving the finding here and if you think my findings are well researched I would love to push new prs
.
